I read the whole file. It has two definitions: `archIdentEquiv` and `archIdentGLHomeo`. Both build on project-specific objects (`genuineInfinitePlaceData.baseChangeRingEquiv`, `archIdent`, `archIdentGL`) and on Mathlib's `Units.mapEquiv`, `Algebra.TensorProduct.comm` and `toHomeomorphOfContinuousOpen`. I found no Mathlib definition they compete with.

The only close match is `isReduced_infiniteAdeleRing`. Mathlib already has the `Pi` instance `IsReduced (∀ i, R i)` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Nilpotent/Defs.lean), and the manual proof duplicates it. That is a standalone theorem duplication and a proof-shortening point, not a competing concept, so the rubric excludes it. The other lemmas (`isUnit_disc_map`, `secondCountableTopology_infiniteAdeleRing` and the rest) are also theorems, not concept duplicates. I did not check every Mathlib corner for `archIdentGLHomeo`. I judged it a named, useful specialisation, so I abstained.
